📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

8. Energy Trend?

🧭 STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor selective exposure to financials and defensive sectors; reduce exposure to technology’s weakness. Style mixed / no clear leadership, with broad strength offset by rising fear and falling SPY.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

BEARISH: If tech weakness persists, reduce exposure to XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -6.49% | 1M: -12.81%).

BEARISH: If energy weakness extends, watch XLE in CORRECTION (1W: -3.43% | 1M: +7.05%) and UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -14.04%).

Financials and defensives show relative strength, while technology lags and style leadership remains mixed. Monitor rising fear alongside weak technology momentum for evidence that the broad sector strength is narrowing.
